name: What should I ask before hiring a bathroom remodel contractor in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a bathroom remodeling contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles or Pasadena?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a bathroom remodeling contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles or Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a bathroom remodel contractor, ask clear questions about scope, schedule, and responsibility. Find out who will actually do the work, how permits and inspections are handled, what waterproofing system they use, and how they handle change orders if hidden damage appears. Ask whether demolition, debris removal, cleanup, and final punch-list work are included. It also helps to ask about similar projects in older Los Angeles-area homes, because plumbing, framing, and electrical conditions can vary a lot from one house to another. A good contractor should explain the process in plain language and give you a written scope that is detailed enough to compare against other bids. The more specific the answers, the less likely you are to face surprise costs later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about permits, waterproofing, timeline, who performs the work, what is excluded, how change orders are handled, and whether they have experience with older homes. You should also confirm licensing, insurance, and whether the bid includes cleanup and inspections.
